external_observations.evidence_span: "I've never seen a more fraudulent company in my life. One of the HR managers  is the main culprit, behaving like a sucking mosquito. Not only me, but the company and HR manager have ruined the lives of many people. They terminate visas, deduct salaries monthly, provide low-quality products to stores, and deduct our salaries every time they repackage products. If we resign from the company, they file labor cases against us by tampering with our daily attendance records. I swear he will face consequences for his actions, and his family will also face the repercussions of his deeds towards the poor staff."They said 8 hours' duty, but they're being super reasonable and giving one Carrefour 12 hours' duty and three Lulu hypermarkets 18 hours' duty daily, and they're also thoughtfully blocking our punching application.
